newsitem.title: CANADA: Ventra to make offer for Tarxien.
newsitem.headline: Ventra to make offer for Tarxien.

text.p: Auto parts manufacturer Ventra Group Inc said it planned to make a C$38 million offer to acquire parts firm Tarxien Corp for C$8 cash and two Ventra common shares for each Tarxien common share.

Ventra said it signed a deal with Rossiter Ventures Corp and Ralph Zarboni, which controls Rossiter, under which Rossiter would tender its 918,213 common shares and Zarboni would tender 146,000 shares resulting from the exercise of his stock options into the bid.
The combined amount of these shares is 33.5 percent of Tarxien's outstanding stock.
Rossiter and Zarboni agreed not to tender to any other offer for 32 days after Ventra's bid.
Tarxien closed on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Friday at C$10, while Ventra ended at C$1.96. Ventra said its offer represented a premium of 19 percent over the closing price of Tarxien stock.
Ventra said the cash part of the bid would be funded through a financing commitment from an unidentified Canadian bank.
The offer is due to be mailed around October 11, subject to certain conditions including the receipt of appropriate regulatory approvals.
Ventra's bid will be conditional upon not less than 90 percent of Tarxien shares being tendered and not withdrawn as well as a recommendation from the Tarxien board.
